CustomObject.description: Audit record written by FQS_CampaignHierarchyBuilder after a successful campaign hierarchy setup run. Stores the chosen model, the IDs of created top-level Campaigns, the ask-creation choice, and the run timestamp. Used for support investigations and as an anchor for future Deep Clone capability. Only one row ships (DeveloperName = Default); it is upserted on each successful run.
